items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey ruled out with a concussion after being evaluated for head injury mid-game.
items.implication: Immediate removal; monitor for next week protocol; targets redistribute in LAC offense.
items.opportunity: Boost to Quentin Johnston and other Chargers WRs remaining snaps/targets.

items.text: Quinshon Judkins inactive. Browns only have Jaleel McLaughlin (5'7/187) and Audric Estime (signed off Vikings PS Tuesday). Tyler Warren inactive. Tyjae Spears active. Still no word on DJ Moore (later inactive).
items.why: Confirmed inactives; thin CLE depth noted specifically.
items.implication: Updated ETR projections; handcuff focus on limited options.
items.opportunity: McLaughlin/Estime snaps/carries; Spears role in TEN.

items.text: Colts TE Tyler Warren is inactive today.
items.why: Appeared on injury report (groin); confirmed inactive.
items.implication: TE streamers elevated; Colts TE usage opens for others.
items.opportunity: Streaming TE opportunity (e.g. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth).

items.text: Bills WR DJ Moore is inactive; Josh Palmer is active.
items.why: Confirmed via inactives; no early word earlier in day.
items.implication: BUF WR targets shift; sit Moore.
items.opportunity: Increased role/opportunity for Josh Palmer and other Bills pass-catchers.

items.text: Actives today include Caleb Williams, Chris Olave, Alvin Kamara (plus Rico Dowdle, Kenyon Sadiq, Ja’Kobi Lane).
items.why: Confirmed active after expected-to-play designations; Williams returning from hamstring.
items.implication: Start with confidence where rostered; Kamara/Olave volume intact.
items.opportunity: Full snaps/routes for Olave and Kamara; Williams QB opportunity vs ATL.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson and (with AJ Brown) both officially active; earlier likely to play.
items.why: Ankle issues but cleared; AJ Brown activated to 53 and expected.
items.implication: NE near full health; Brown immediate WR upside, Henderson RB role.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Brown; carries for Henderson in committee.

items.text: Tyler Warren inactive surprising despite injury report. Juwan Johnson, Freiermuth and Higbee among favorite streamer TEs.
items.why: Warren out opens streaming TE spots.
items.implication: Pivot to available TEs for week.
items.opportunity: TE streaming targets with potential targets/redzone.

items.text: Titans RB Tyjae Spears is active today.
items.why: Confirmed active alongside Warren inactive news.
items.implication: TEN backfield competition/usage share; Spears viable if volume materializes.
items.opportunity: Carries and potential goal-line work in Titans offense.

items.text: If starting a NYG RB still starting Cam Skattebo as explosiveness gives best chance at score (esp vs NO), but riskier now; more flex than RB2. Was on pre-season hate list. Updated ranks: Skattebo RB28, Najee RB33.
items.why: Rotation change expected after fumbles; still prefers for upside vs NO.
items.implication: Start if needed but lower confidence; prefer in flex over pure RB2.
items.opportunity: Explosiveness/TD chance remains; monitor actual snap split.
items.conflict: Prefers Skattebo over pure volume plays sometimes despite downgrade.

items.text: Cam Skattebo currently 37th out of 43 qualifying RBs in rush yards over expectation. He's also fumbled four times (lost one). Amid reports of Giants RB rotation change favoring larger Najee role.
items.why: Poor YOE efficiency + fumbles; sources indicate Najee larger role, all 4 RBs active.
items.implication: Riskier start; efficiency concerns persist even if involved.
items.opportunity: Potential snap/carry increase for Najee Harris and other NYG RBs.

items.text: Weekend fantasy reports summary: GTD Judkins/Warren/Evans/Kirk; Expected Caleb/Olave/Kamara/AJB/Henderson/Metcalf/Freiermuth/Sadiq; Not expected Deebo/Croskey-Merritt/Tucker; Activated Jaydon Blue.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for Sunday monitoring windows.
items.implication: Core tracking list for last-minute decisions and projections updates.
items.opportunity: Monitor beneficiaries on outs; full roles for expected.

items.text: Eagles QB Jalen Hurts placed on IR, out indefinitely/for foreseeable future after doctor consultations.
items.why: Blood clot/medical consultations led to IR.
items.implication: Long-term absence; PHI QB and offense cascade effects ongoing.
items.opportunity: Backup QB and skill player usage shifts in PHI.

items.text: Guess split between Cam & Najee; everyone can run vs Saints so Harris better shot than DK Metcalf vs TB at a TD. Go Najee in that choice.
items.why: Matchup and expected larger Najee role post-fumbles.
items.implication: Prefer Najee in flex decisions over some WRs.
items.opportunity: TD upside in split backfield vs soft run D.

items.text: Deebo Samuel not expected to play.
items.why: Included in ETR weekend not-expected list.
items.implication: Sit; WAS WR targets to others.
items.opportunity: Increased work for remaining Commanders pass-catchers.

items.text: DK Metcalf and Pat Freiermuth expected to play (Freiermuth optimistic per sources despite late addition to report).
items.why: ETR summary and Rapoport optimism on Freiermuth.
items.opportunity: Metcalf routes/targets; Freiermuth TE streaming if needed.

items.text: Week 6 Love includes Mike Evans (WR4 vs WSH), Drake London (WR6 vs CHI), George Kittle (TE3 vs WSH), Kyren Williams (RB5 vs ARI), Javonte Williams (RB8 @ GB), Rhamondre Stevenson (RB9 vs NYJ), Brock Purdy (QB2 vs WSH).
items.why: Soft matchups, bankable usage/volume, high-scoring spots, goal-line roles.
items.implication: Prioritize in lineups; strong weekly upside.
items.opportunity: High target/carry/redzone shares in favorable games.

items.text: Week 6 Hate includes Jaylen Waddle (WR28 vs SEA), Emeka Egbuka (WR34 vs PIT); also fades in other spots per column.
items.why: Tough matchups and lesser projected output.
items.implication: Sit or fade in favor of better spots.
